issues.message: 485 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.

notes.detail: Barrels, trapdoor counters, chests and plank benches give the stalls something, but the square itself is plain paving and a bare cross stub.
notes.roof: Stall roofs are flat two-tier wool awnings: right for market stalls, but no pitch or trim.
notes.shape: Four identical stalls in a strict mirror; the stub cross is the only centrepiece.
notes.life: No lanterns, plants or flowers yet (they come at L2/L3); only mossy cobblestone in the paving.
notes.grandeur: Reads as a modest market; the cross is too small to anchor the square at this level.

visual.summary: Level 1 is the shell: a 15 x 15 paved square with gravel aisles, four closed wooden stalls with red-white and brown-white awnings, benches and a small stepped stone cross. Clean and readable, but plain.
problems: Note only: meta.groundLayer 0, the paving replaces the grass (builders can't do that yet).
Description says 620 blocks; this level has 485 (620 is the L3 count).
Reachability: 196 of 280 standing places reached; the unreached ones are only the stall awning tops (y 4..5) and barrel tops, which is fine. The square, aisles and every stall front are reached.

issues.message: 497 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.

notes.roof: Stall awnings are flat striped canopies, right for stalls but not a pitched roof.
notes.life: Flush poppy beds round the cross; no lanterns yet (they come at L2).
notes.levels: Base of the set: paved square, four stalls, stepped cross, benches. L2 and L3 build visibly on it.

visual.summary: The market square shell: paved square with gravel aisles, four striped stalls with barrels and produce, a stepped stone cross with flush flower beds and benches.
problems: Note only: meta.groundLayer 0, the paving replaces the grass (builders can't do that yet).
